summary.cost_basis: Total fuel cost includes rounded station purchases and the value of fuel consumed from the starting full tank, priced at the average station purchase price.

assumptions.starting_fuel: Vehicle starts with a full tank; starting tank value is included in total fuel cost.
assumptions.price_rule: median of duplicate CSV rows per station ID
assumptions.stop_penalty_policy: exact breakpoint DP when non-zero; default 0 uses the exact greedy fast path
assumptions.cost_policy: total fuel cost equals station purchases plus consumed starting-tank fuel at the price basis
assumptions.detours: Stations within the corridor are treated as on-route; detour miles are not charged.
